jobs.prompt: Seventh static security review of coordination/review/aa-new7.diff: auto-approve v1, now FILE-EDIT WINDOWS ONLY (no git capability at all: every git command stays owner-only as on main; the swarm merge standing path is unchanged). A policy window may auto-approve Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and analysed shell writes of EXACT files with extensions .md .txt .json .ndjson .csv .yaml .yml inside docs/plans, docs/state, docs/scope, docs/design and the routing notes main already allows, never tools, tests, .github, .swarm, .git, job manifests, coordination review files or the project pointer. Promises: exact-file entries only (no folder or prefix match); every written path re-checked at write time against folders and extensions; lstat-based symlink and dangling-symlink rejection; kill switch, expiry, per-window and per-day caps and stats protection on every approval path; stats initialised by the policy with a marker and never fail-open; policy file and override variables ignored outside the signed test marker; SAFE_SWARM anchored and every segment of a compound command tested; ssh and git config files protected; orchestrator mode gains nothing; git behaves exactly as on main. Previous findings (fifth review) that still apply to this scope: folder entries and code files in windows, dangling symlinks, stats never initialised, SAFE_SWARM anchoring, env overrides under the temp dir, protected files. Check each and look for NEW bypasses or fail-open paths, including: any remaining way a policy window can cover a git command or a command that runs code, a window file that is a hard link or a path reached through a symlinked ancestor, case-insensitive filesystem tricks, files inside allowed folders that other tools execute or trust (hooks, CI configs, scripts referenced from docs, package scripts), and the guard paths for shell writes (redirects, tee, sed -i, mv, cp onto a window file from a protected one). No exploit commands. Verdict PASS or FAIL, ranked findings with severity. The sixth review (FAIL) found: H write-time re-check skipped when a covered path is spelled differently from the listed one; H hard links not rejected; H opaque commands failing open when no window is live; H policy windows carrying git ops; M orchestrator mode gaining swarm handbuild git; M node swarm.mjs subcommands no longer producing a swarm op; M override variables honoured under the temp dir; M allowed folders feeding trusted processes (docs/scope, docs/plans, json and yaml). The allowed set is now docs/state and docs/design plus main's routing notes, extensions .md .txt .csv .ndjson. Confirm each is fixed, that the diff of the guard files against main changes nothing about git handling, and look for new bypasses.
